description: This file defines the DashboardFragment class for an Android TV application. It manages a RecyclerView grid displaying device cards, with functionality to toggle device states, display device counts, and handle focus navigation for TV remote control.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class managing device items in the RecyclerView, including Device nested data class and device types.

methods.name: DeviceAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing device list and toggle callback.

methods.name: DeviceAdapter.Device
methods.description: Data class representing a device with id, name, type, and on/off state.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView, adapter, focus, and device count display.

methods.name: updateCount
methods.description: Counts the number of devices that are ON and updates the display.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DashboardFragment.
